errors.text_span: 青绿色柱状图代表"该日全球确诊数量"

The reference description explicitly states the chart illustrates the '变化趋势' (trend) and '同步波动特征' (synchronous fluctuation characteristics) between cases and media reports, including the lag effect. The machine-generated description omits this interpretive context about trends and relationships.
The reference description mentions the legend ('该日全球确诊数量' and '有关covid-19新闻数量'), but the machine-generated description does not explicitly state the presence of a legend or describe its content.
